page.layout: One column of index entries, with page numbers at the right of each line; "INDEX." heading at top; signature "Ss 5" and catchword "Somno" at the foot.

main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: Serpentes ut innoxiè edi possint praparandi[?] mo-dus 238
Siccum & frigidum an sit omne durum 445
Signa prudentia, fortitudinis, timiditatis à sanguine petenda 119

page.notes: Signature "Ss 5" read with doubt: the numeral resembles a long s/5 and is marked [?]. "praparandi" is as printed and may be a misprint for "praeparandi"; marked [?]. The page numbers "509.512" and "605.608.610" are copied as printed. The long s is normalised to plain s throughout. The "&" in the entries is the printed ampersand ligature.
